primary.purpose: The single brand anchor. Primary buttons, nav brand block, category badges, active states, focus rings.

primary-light.purpose: Selected state backgrounds, badge fills, hover surface tints.

link.purpose: Text-link actions in tables — แก้ไข (edit). Distinct from navy brand.

success.purpose: Success states, completed status, healthy indicators.

surface.purpose: All primary content surfaces: cards, tables, form panels.

shadows.name: modal-high
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs, Drawer panels, notification toasts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Navy filled button. All primary actions: สร้างแบบฟอร์ม, ค้นหา, บันทึก.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">สร้างแบบฟอร์ม</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1E3869; color: #fff; padding: 4px 15px; height: 32px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2A4D8A; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #14264A; }

components.name: Category Badge
components.description: Navy filled badge for content categories.
components.css: .ds-badge-category { background: #1E3869; color: #fff; padding: 0 8px; height: 22px; line-height: 22px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Top Navigation Bar
components.description: White bar with navy brand block on left and underline active indicator.
components.css: .ds-topnav { display: flex; height: 50px; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #D9D9D9; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-topnav-brand { background: #1E3869; color: #fff; padding: 0 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: 700; } .ds-topnav-menu { display: flex; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 4px; } .ds-topnav-menu li { padding: 0 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; color: #595959; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-topnav-menu li.ds-active { color: #1E3869; font-weight: 600; border-bottom-color: #1E3869; }

narrative.overview: NIT_Plus uses a single brand anchor — Institutional Navy #1E3869 — that appears on primary buttons, navigation chrome, category badges, and active states. This consolidation gives the system institutional weight without visual fragmentation.
keyCharacteristics: Single navy brand anchor across all primary actions and structural elements
White content surfaces on light gray page background
Noto Sans Thai priority for bilingual readability
Flat surfaces with elevation only for modals and overlays
Functional color signals (green/gold/red) reserved for status only

rules.name: The Single Anchor Rule
rules.body: Navy is the only brand color. Never introduce a competing accent.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Link Blue means edit. Danger Red means delete. Green/Gold/Red mean status.

rules.name: The Thai-First Rule
rules.body: Every text rendering decision is tested in Thai script first.

dos: Do use Institutional Navy (#1E3869) as the single brand anchor
Do keep page backgrounds at #F0F2F5 and card surfaces at #FFFFFF
Do use Link Blue (#1677FF) for แก้ไข and Danger Red (#FF4D4F) for ลบ
Do test every text label in Thai script first
donts: Don't introduce a competing brand color (teal, purple, etc.)
Don't use border-left accent stripes as decoration
